newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares seen mixed, good volume.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares seen mixed, good volume.

text.p: 1720 GMT - Shares were seen continuing mixed, providing there were no surprises in New York overnight, with volumes remaining good. Interest would stay highly focused, traders said.

*The slight weakness of Portugal Telecom -- with the selling coming from small investors and employees taking profit on stock picked up at the privatisation -- and some selling of Banco Comercial Portugues weighed on the market index.
*Sonae Industria gained 3.3 percent to 1,464 escudos although it was off its highs. Traders see a target of 1,500 escudos as investors bet on better than previously predicted results for 1996.
*The bulk of the 350,000 shares traded in Banco Espirito Santo involved a single trade which was probably a portfolio adjustment, traders said.
*PSI index closes 0.31 percent down at 5,034.54, with futures off 17 points at 5,039.
